credential.en: Presented Scholar, first of the first class
Presented Scholar, second of the first class

label.en: Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent
dismissed never to be employed again

units.zh: 沈桂芬，字經笙，順天宛平人，本籍江蘇吳江。
units.en: Shen Guifen, courtesy name Jingsheng, was registered in Wanping, Shuntian, though his family hailed from Wujiang in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Shen Guifen, styled Jingsheng, was a native of Wanping in Shuntian; his ancestral home was Wujiang in Jiangsu.

units.zh: 道光二十七年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in 1847, entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationer, and was appointed a compiler.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 咸豐二年，大考一等，擢庶子。
units.en: In 1852 he placed in the top class in the palace examination and was promoted to junior tutor in the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, in the triennial examination he ranked in the first class and was promoted to junior tutor.

units.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
units.en: He rose step by step to become an academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 先後典浙江、廣東鄉試，督陝甘學政，充會試副總裁。
units.en: He later served as chief examiner for the provincial examinations in Zhejiang and Guangdong, as educational commissioner for Shaanxi and Gansu, and as associate chief examiner of the metropolitan examination.
units.literal: He successively presided over the provincial examinations of Zhejiang and Guangdong, supervised education in Shaanxi and Gansu, and served as associate chief examiner of the metropolitan examination.

units.zh: 八年，丁父憂。
units.en: In 1858 he withdrew to observe mourning for his father.
units.literal: In the eighth year he entered mourning for his father.

units.zh: 服闋，補原官。
units.en: When his mourning ended, he returned to his former office.
units.literal: When the mourning period ended, he resumed his former post.

units.zh: 晉禮部左侍郎。
units.en: He was promoted to Left Vice Minister of Rites.
units.literal: He was advanced to Left Vice Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 同治二年，出署山西巡撫，明年，實授。
units.en: In 1863 he was sent out as acting governor of Shanxi, and the following year received the substantive appointment.
units.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he went out to serve as acting governor of Shanxi; the next year he received the substantive appointment.

units.zh: 連上移屯、練兵諸疏，並稱旨。
units.en: He submitted a series of memorials on frontier settlement and military training, each of which met with the emperor's approval.
units.literal: He repeatedly submitted memorials on colonization and troop training, and all won imperial approval.

units.zh: 桂芬以山西民食不敷，自洋藥弛禁，栽種罌粟，糧價踴增。
units.en: Guifen argued that Shanxi could not feed its people: once the ban on imported opium was eased, farmers turned to poppy cultivation and grain prices shot up.
units.literal: Guifen held that the people's food supply in Shanxi was insufficient; since the ban on foreign opium had been relaxed, poppies were cultivated and grain prices soared.

units.zh: 於是刊發條約，飭屬嚴禁。
units.en: He therefore published the treaty provisions and ordered his subordinates to enforce a strict ban.
units.literal: Thereupon he published the treaty provisions and ordered his subordinates to enforce a strict prohibition.

units.zh: 疏陳現辦情形，上韙之，頒行各省，著為令。
units.en: In a memorial he described the measures he had taken; the court endorsed his approach, ordered it circulated to every province, and made it standing policy.
units.literal: In a memorial he set forth how the matter was being handled; the throne approved and ordered it promulgated in every province as a standing regulation.

units.zh: 旋丁母憂。
units.en: He soon withdrew again to mourn his mother.
units.literal: Soon afterward he entered mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 六年，起禮部右侍郎，充經筵講官，命為軍機大臣。
units.en: In 1867 he was recalled as Right Vice Minister of Rites, appointed lecturer at the Classics Colloquium, and named to the Grand Council.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was recalled as Right Vice Minister of Rites, appointed lecturer at the imperial lectures, and ordered to serve on the Grand Council.

units.zh: 歷戶部、吏部，擢都察院左都御史，兼總理各國事務大臣。
units.en: He served in the Ministries of Revenue and Personnel, was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief, and concurrently became a minister for foreign affairs.
units.literal: He passed through the Ministries of Revenue and Personnel, was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate, and concurrently served as minister in charge of foreign affairs with all nations.

units.zh: 遷兵部尚書，加太子少保。
units.en: He was transferred to Minister of War and given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: He was transferred to Minister of War and given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 光緒元年，以本官協辦大學士。
units.en: In 1875, while retaining his ministerial rank, he was appointed associate grand secretary.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangxu, with his existing rank he was made associate grand secretary.

units.zh: 京畿旱，編修何金壽援漢代天災策免三公為言，請責斥樞臣，諭交部議。
units.en: When drought struck the capital region, compiler He Jinshou cited the Han precedent of dismissing the Three Excellencies after natural disasters and demanded that the Grand Councilors be held responsible; the throne ordered the ministries to deliberate.
units.literal: When drought struck the capital region, compiler He Jinshou cited the Han practice of dismissing the Three Excellencies in response to heavenly calamities and asked that the Grand Councilors be held accountable; an edict ordered the matter referred to the ministries for deliberation.

units.zh: 桂芬坐革職，特旨改為革職留任。
units.en: Guifen was found liable for dismissal, but a special edict allowed him to remain in office despite the demotion.
units.literal: Guifen was sentenced to dismissal from office, but a special edict changed this to dismissal while retaining his post.

units.zh: 旋復原官，充翰林院掌院學士，晉太子太保。
units.en: He was soon restored to his former rank, appointed chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and promoted to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: Soon he was restored to his former rank, appointed chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and advanced to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 桂芬遇事持重，自文祥逝後，以諳究外情稱。
units.en: Guifen was known for his steady judgment; after Wen Xiang's death he was regarded as the councilor best versed in foreign affairs.
units.literal: Guifen was deliberate in handling affairs; after Wen Xiang's death he was known for his thorough understanding of foreign conditions.

units.zh: 日本之滅琉球也，廷論多主戰，桂芬獨言勞師海上，易損國威，力持不可。
units.en: When Japan annexed Ryukyu, most at court favored war, but Guifen alone argued that sending troops to sea would squander strength and damage national prestige, and he firmly opposed hostilities.
units.literal: When Japan extinguished Ryukyu, court opinion largely favored war; Guifen alone argued that exhausting troops at sea would easily damage national prestige and firmly held that war must not be undertaken.

units.zh: 及與俄人議還伊犁，崇厚擅訂約，朝議紛然；
units.en: When negotiations with Russia over the return of Ili began, Chonghou had signed a treaty on his own authority, throwing the court into uproar;
units.literal: When negotiations with Russia over the return of Ili were under way, Chonghou had on his own authority concluded a treaty, and court debate was in turmoil;

units.zh: 桂芬委曲斡旋，易使往議，改約始定，而言者猶激論不已。
units.en: Guifen worked behind the scenes to arrange a new mission; only then was a revised treaty settled, though critics at court continued to argue without end.
units.literal: Guifen worked tactfully to mediate, sent another envoy to negotiate, and only then was a revised treaty settled, yet critics still argued heatedly without cease.

units.zh: 桂芬久臥病，六年，卒，年六十有四，贈太子太傅，諡文定。
units.en: Guifen had been ill for a long time; he died in 1880 at sixty-four, was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, and was given the posthumous title Wending.
units.literal: Guifen had long been bedridden with illness; in the sixth year he died at the age of sixty-four, was posthumously given Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, and received the posthumous title Wending.

units.zh: 桂芬躬行謹飭，為軍機大臣十餘年，自奉若寒素，所處極湫隘，而未嘗以清節自矜，人以為難雲。
units.en: Guifen was scrupulous in his private life; for more than a decade on the Grand Council he lived as frugally as a poor scholar in cramped quarters, yet never flaunted his integrity—an example people found hard to equal.
units.literal: Guifen was scrupulous in personal conduct; for more than ten years as a Grand Councilor he lived as if in poverty, his dwelling extremely cramped and mean, yet he never prided himself on incorruptibility—people regarded this as hard to match.

units.zh: 李鴻藻，字蘭孫，直隸高陽人。
units.en: Li Hongzao, courtesy name Lansun, was from Gaoyang in Zhili.
units.literal: Li Hongzao, styled Lansun, was a native of Gaoyang in Zhili.

units.zh: 咸豐二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: He earned his jinshi degree in 1852, entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationer, and was appointed a compiler.
units.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 典山西鄉試，督河南學政。
units.en: He presided over the Shanxi provincial examination and served as educational commissioner for Henan.
units.literal: He presided over the Shanxi provincial examination and supervised education in Henan.

units.zh: 十年，上擇儒臣為皇子師，大學士彭蘊章以鴻藻應。
units.en: In 1860 the emperor sought Confucian scholars to tutor the princes; Grand Secretary Peng Yunzhang recommended Hongzao.
units.literal: In the tenth year the emperor chose Confucian officials to tutor the princes; Grand Secretary Peng Yunzhang recommended Hongzao.

units.zh: 召來京，明年，特詔授大阿哥讀。
units.en: He was summoned to the capital, and the following year a special edict named him tutor to the heir apparent.
units.literal: He was summoned to the capital; the next year a special edict appointed him tutor to the eldest imperial son.

units.zh: 穆宗登極，皇太后懿旨命直弘德殿。
units.en: When Emperor Tongzhi ascended the throne, the Empress Dowager ordered him to serve in Hongde Hall.
units.literal: When Emperor Muzong ascended the throne, the Empress Dowager's decree ordered him to attend at Hongde Hall.

units.zh: 同治元年，擢侍講。
units.en: In 1862 he was promoted to lecturing reader.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was promoted to lecturing reader.

units.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
units.en: He rose step by step to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 署戶部左侍郎。
units.en: He served as acting Left Vice Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: He served as acting Left Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 四年，命直軍機。
units.en: In 1865 he was appointed to the Grand Council.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered to attend on the Grand Council.

units.zh: 五年，授禮部右侍郎。
units.en: In 1866 he was appointed Right Vice Minister of Rites.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Right Vice Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 遭母憂，皇太后懿旨，援雍正、乾隆年大臣孫嘉淦等故事，命鴻藻開缺守孝，百日後仍授讀，兼參機務。
units.en: When his mother died, the Empress Dowager cited precedents from the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns involving ministers such as Sun Jiagan and ordered Hongzao to leave office for mourning, but after a hundred days to resume tutoring the emperor while continuing to serve on the Grand Council.
units.literal: When his mother died, the Empress Dowager's decree, citing the precedents of ministers such as Sun Jiagan in the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns, ordered Hongzao to vacate his post and observe mourning, yet after a hundred days to resume tutoring and concurrently take part in council affairs.

units.zh: 並諭：「移孝作忠，勿以守禮固辭。」
units.en: She also instructed: "Let filial duty become loyal service; do not refuse on grounds of ritual propriety."
units.literal: She also instructed: "Transform filial piety into loyalty; do not obstinately refuse on grounds of ritual propriety."

units.zh: 鴻藻懇終制，不允。
units.en: Hongzao pleaded to observe the full mourning term, but was refused.
units.literal: Hongzao earnestly asked to complete the full mourning term; this was not granted.

units.zh: 倭仁等亦代為陳請，仍命恭親王傳諭慰勉。
units.en: Woren and others petitioned on his behalf as well, but the court still had Prince Gong convey the edict and urge him to comply.
units.literal: Woren and others also pleaded on his behalf, yet the order still stood for Prince Gong to convey the edict and offer encouragement.

units.zh: 鴻藻連疏稱疾，遂得賜告，卒終制始出。
units.en: Hongzao repeatedly memorialized that he was ill and was granted leave; he did not return until he had completed the full mourning period.
units.literal: Hongzao repeatedly memorialized claiming illness and thereby obtained leave; only when he had completed the full mourning did he emerge.

units.zh: 七年，捻擾畿疆，鴻藻方里居，以各路統兵大員事權不一，疏請特派親王為大將軍，坐鎮京師，以固北路；
units.en: In 1868, while the Nian rebels threatened the capital region, Hongzao was at home on leave; noting that commanders along the various fronts lacked unified authority, he memorialized that a prince of the blood be appointed grand general, stationed at the capital to secure the northern approaches;
units.literal: In the seventh year, when the Nian rebels harassed the capital region, Hongzao was living at home; because the commanders of the various routes lacked unified authority, he memorialized asking that a prince of the blood be specially appointed grand general, stationed at the capital to secure the northern route;

units.zh: 左宗棠、李鴻章為參贊大臣，分扎保定、河間東西兩路，各率所部兵勇相機剿辦；
units.en: with Zuo Zongtang and Li Hongzhang as deputy commanders, encamped at Baoding and Hejian on the eastern and western routes respectively, each leading his own forces to pursue the rebels as opportunity allowed;
units.literal: Zuo Zongtang and Li Hongzhang should serve as deputy grand ministers, encamped respectively at Baoding and Hejian on the eastern and western routes, each leading his own troops to suppress the rebels as circumstances allowed;

units.zh: 陳國瑞為幫辦軍務，專統一軍為游擊之師；
units.en: Chen Guorui should assist in military affairs and command a separate army as a mobile strike force;
units.literal: Chen Guorui should assist in military affairs, solely commanding one army as a mobile strike force;

units.zh: 直隸總督官文專顧省城，籌備諸軍餉需，以資接濟；
units.en: Governor-General Guanwen of Zhili should remain at the provincial capital to provision the armies;
units.literal: Governor-General Guanwen of Zhili should focus on the provincial capital, preparing supplies for all armies to provide support;

units.zh: 丁寶楨駐紮直、東交界，防賊東竄；
units.en: Ding Baozhen should be posted on the Zhili-Shandong border to block an eastern breakout;
units.literal: Ding Baozhen should be stationed at the border of Zhili and Shandong to guard against the rebels fleeing east;

units.zh: 李鶴年駐紮直、豫交界，防賊南竄；
units.en: Li Henian should be posted on the Zhili-Henan border to block a southern breakout;
units.literal: Li Henian should be stationed at the border of Zhili and Henan to guard against the rebels fleeing south;

units.zh: 直、晉交界，由左宗棠等分撥勁旅扼要駐紮；
units.en: at the Zhili-Shanxi border, Zuo Zongtang and others should detach elite troops to hold the key passes;
units.literal: At the border of Zhili and Shanxi, Zuo Zongtang and others should detach elite troops to hold key positions;

units.zh: 並請敕下各該大臣和衷商辦，迅奏膚功。
units.en: and he asked that an edict order all these commanders to cooperate in good faith and report swift success.
units.literal: and he asked that an edict be issued ordering all these ministers to cooperate in good faith and quickly report complete victory.

units.zh: 奏入，上遂命各路統兵大臣均歸恭親王節制。
units.en: When the memorial reached the throne, the emperor ordered all field commanders placed under Prince Gong's command.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor thereupon ordered that all field commanders along the various routes come under Prince Gong's command.

units.zh: 旋起禮部左侍郎，仍直弘德殿及軍機如故。
units.en: He was soon recalled as Left Vice Minister of Rites and resumed his duties in Hongde Hall and on the Grand Council.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled as Left Vice Minister of Rites and continued to attend at Hongde Hall and on the Grand Council as before.

units.zh: 十年，擢都察院左都御史，加太子少保。
units.en: In 1871 he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief and given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate and given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 時有修葺圓明園之旨，朝臣同起力爭。
units.en: When an edict ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace, officials at court protested in unison.
units.literal: At that time there was an edict to repair the Old Summer Palace, and court officials rose together to protest vigorously.

units.zh: 鴻藻亦言：「粵、捻初平，回氛方熾，宜培養元氣，以固根本。
units.en: Hongzao also argued: "The Taiping and Nian rebellions have only just ended and Muslim unrest is still fierce; the court should conserve its strength and shore up its foundations.
units.literal: Hongzao also said: "The Guangdong rebels and the Nian have only just been pacified, while Muslim unrest is still fierce; the state should nurture its vital energies to strengthen its foundations.

units.zh: 不應虛糜帑糈，為此不急之務。」
units.en: Treasury funds should not be squandered on so inessential a project."
units.literal: Treasury funds should not be squandered on so unurgent a task."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: The project was halted.
units.literal: Thereupon the project was halted.

units.zh: 十三年，上有疾，命代批答章奏；
units.en: In 1874 the emperor fell ill and ordered him to draft replies to memorials;
units.literal: In the thirteenth year the emperor fell ill and ordered him to draft replies to memorials on his behalf;

units.zh: 旋崩，自劾輔導無狀，罷弘德殿行走。
units.en: the emperor soon died; Hongzao impeached himself for failing as tutor and was dismissed from Hongde Hall.
units.literal: soon the emperor died; Hongzao impeached himself for failure in tutoring, and was removed from attendance at Hongde Hall.

units.zh: 光緒二年，命兼總理各國事務衙門。
units.en: In 1876 he was appointed concurrently to the foreign affairs yamen.
units.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was ordered concurrently to serve at the Yamen for the management of affairs of all nations.

units.zh: 尋丁本生母憂，服闋，起故官，以兵部尚書協辦大學士，調吏部。
units.en: He soon mourned his birth mother; when mourning ended he returned to office as Minister of War and associate grand secretary, then was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: Soon he entered mourning for his birth mother; when mourning ended he resumed his former post, and as Minister of War served as associate grand secretary before being transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 時崇厚與俄擅定伊犁約，鴻藻堅持不可，爭於廷。
units.en: When Chonghou signed the Ili treaty with Russia on his own authority, Hongzao firmly opposed it and argued the matter at court.
units.literal: At that time Chonghou had on his own authority concluded the Ili treaty with Russia; Hongzao firmly held that it could not stand and argued in court.

units.zh: 卒治崇厚罪，議改約。
units.en: Chonghou was eventually punished and a revised treaty negotiated.
units.literal: In the end Chonghou was punished, and a revised treaty was negotiated.

units.zh: 及法越啟釁，言路愈奮發，劾罷樞臣。
units.en: When war broke out between France and Vietnam, censors grew bolder still and impeached the Grand Councilors from office.
units.literal: When hostilities opened between France and Vietnam, the censorial remonstrators grew ever more vehement and impeached the Grand Councilors until they were dismissed.

units.zh: 鴻藻謫遷內閣學士。
units.en: Hongzao was demoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: Hongzao was demoted and transferred to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 後復累遷禮部尚書。
units.en: He was later promoted again to Minister of Rites.
units.literal: Later he was again promoted in succession to Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 十三年，河決鄭州，上命鴻藻馳往督辦。
units.en: In 1887 the Yellow River burst its banks at Zhengzhou; the emperor ordered Hongzao to hurry there and supervise the works.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year the Yellow River burst its banks at Zhengzhou; the emperor ordered Hongzao to hurry there and supervise repairs.

units.zh: 先是河道總督李鶴年、河南巡撫倪文蔚議於西壩興工，鴻藻至，仍之。
units.en: Canal director Li Henian and Henan governor Ni Wenwei had already decided to begin work on the western embankment; when Hongzao arrived, he continued their plan.
units.literal: Earlier, Director-General of the Grand Canal Li Henian and Governor of Henan Ni Wenwei had decided to begin work at the western embankment; when Hongzao arrived, he continued the plan.

units.zh: 又續興東壩工。
units.en: He also pressed ahead with work on the eastern embankment.
units.literal: He also continued work on the eastern embankment.

units.zh: 疊遇奇險，皆力為固守。
units.en: Despite repeated crises, he threw all his strength into holding the works.
units.literal: Repeatedly encountering extraordinary dangers, he exerted himself to hold firm.

units.zh: 會伏秋汛至，西壩失事，請暫停工。
units.en: When the summer and autumn floods arrived, the western embankment gave way and he requested a temporary halt.
units.literal: When the midsummer and autumn flood season arrived, the western embankment failed; he requested a temporary halt to work.

units.zh: 上以鴻藻督率無方，革職留任；
units.en: The emperor found Hongzao's supervision inadequate and ordered him dismissed from office while retaining his duties;
units.literal: The emperor held that Hongzao had supervised without method and dismissed him from office while retaining his post;

units.zh: 並奪李鶴年河道總督，命鴻藻暫行署理。
units.en: Li Henian was stripped of the canal directorship and Hongzao was ordered to act in his place.
units.literal: Li Henian was also stripped of the canal directorship, and Hongzao was ordered to act in his place for the time being.

units.zh: 尋回京，復以禮部具奏典禮漏繕簽改日期，再議革職，上特寬免。
units.en: He soon returned to the capital; the Ministry of Rites then reported that a date on a ritual memorial had been omitted and altered, and dismissal was proposed again, but the emperor granted special leniency.
units.literal: Soon he returned to the capital; again the Ministry of Rites reported that in a ritual memorial a date on the endorsement had been omitted and altered, and dismissal was again proposed, but the emperor specially granted leniency.

units.zh: 大婚禮成，復原官。
units.en: After the grand wedding ceremony his former rank was restored.
units.literal: When the grand wedding ceremony was completed, his former rank was restored.

units.zh: 二十年，日韓事棘，命鴻藻商辦軍務，再授軍機大臣。
units.en: In 1894, as tensions between Japan and Korea mounted, Hongzao was ordered to handle military affairs and was again appointed to the Grand Council.
units.literal: In the twentieth year, when affairs between Japan and Korea grew critical, Hongzao was ordered to discuss military affairs and was again appointed a Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 與翁同龢皆主戰，並爭和約，卒不能阻。
units.en: He and Weng Tonghe both favored war and fought the peace treaty together, but in the end could not stop it.
units.literal: He and Weng Tonghe both favored war and together opposed the peace treaty, but in the end could not prevent it.

units.zh: 旋以禮部尚書協辦大學士，調吏部。
units.en: He was soon made associate grand secretary while Minister of Rites, then transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: Soon, as Minister of Rites, he served as associate grand secretary and was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 歷蒙頒賞書畫及諸上方珍物。
units.en: He received repeated gifts from the throne of paintings, calligraphy, and other imperial treasures.
units.literal: He repeatedly received gifts of paintings, calligraphy, and various imperial treasures from the throne.

units.zh: 充鄉試、會試、殿試等閱卷大臣。
units.en: He served as chief examiner for the provincial, metropolitan, and palace examinations.
units.literal: He served as grading officer for the provincial, metropolitan, and palace examinations.

units.zh: 二十三年，以病乞假，疾篤，賞給藥餌，命御醫往視。
units.en: In 1897 he asked leave on grounds of illness; when his condition worsened, the court sent medicines and an imperial physician.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year he asked leave on grounds of illness; when his condition grew grave, medicines were bestowed and an imperial physician was sent to attend him.

units.zh: 卒，年七十有八。
units.en: He died at the age of seventy-eight.
units.literal: He died at the age of seventy-eight.

units.zh: 遺疏入，上震悼，予諡文正，贈太子太傅。
units.en: When his final memorial arrived, the emperor was deeply grieved, granted him the posthumous title Wenzheng, and made him Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: When his final memorial was submitted, the emperor was deeply shaken with grief, granted the posthumous title Wenzheng, and bestowed Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 子焜瀛、煜瀛，均賞給郎中。
units.en: His sons Kunying and Yuying were both granted the rank of director in a ministry.
units.literal: His sons Kunying and Yuying were both granted the rank of director in a ministry.

units.zh: 鴻藻性至孝，為學守程硃，務實踐，持躬儉約。
units.en: Hongzao was deeply filial by nature; in scholarship he followed the Cheng-Zhu school and stressed practical conduct, living frugally himself.
units.literal: Hongzao was by nature deeply filial; in learning he adhered to the Cheng-Zhu school and stressed practical conduct, living frugally in personal conduct.

units.zh: 傅穆宗十餘年，盡心啟沃。
units.en: He tutored Emperor Tongzhi for more than a decade and devoted himself wholeheartedly to the young emperor's education.
units.literal: He tutored Emperor Muzong for more than ten years and devoted his whole heart to nurturing him.

units.zh: 一日，穆宗學書，故為戲筆。
units.en: One day, while the emperor was practicing calligraphy, he deliberately made playful strokes.
units.literal: One day, while Emperor Muzong was practicing calligraphy, he deliberately made playful strokes.

units.zh: 鴻藻立前捧上手曰：「皇上心不靜，請少息。」
units.en: Hongzao stood before him, took the emperor's hands in his own, and said: "Your Majesty's mind is unsettled; please pause a moment."
units.literal: Hongzao stood before him, took the emperor's hand in both of his, and said: "Your Majesty's mind is not calm; please rest a moment."

units.zh: 穆宗改容謝之。
units.en: The emperor changed his manner and apologized.
units.literal: Emperor Muzong changed his expression and apologized.

units.zh: 其在樞府，獨守正持大體。
units.en: On the Grand Council he alone upheld principle and kept sight of the larger stakes.
units.literal: In the Grand Council he alone upheld rectitude and held to the larger principles.

units.zh: 御史王鵬運諫止修頤和園，幾獲重譴，鴻藻力解之，得免。
units.en: Censor Wang Pengyun protested repairs to the Summer Palace and nearly incurred severe punishment; Hongzao interceded vigorously and saved him.
units.literal: Censor Wang Pengyun remonstrated against repairing the Summer Palace and nearly incurred severe punishment; Hongzao vigorously interceded for him and he was spared.

units.zh: 德宗間日一往頤和園侍起居，時留駐蹕。
units.en: Emperor Guangxu went every other day to the Summer Palace to attend the Empress Dowager, and sometimes remained there for extended stays.
units.literal: Emperor Dezong went every other day to the Summer Palace to attend to the Empress Dowager's daily needs, and sometimes stayed there in residence.

units.zh: 言官有言其不便者，太后大怒，欲黜之，鴻藻謂如此必失天下臣民之望，乃止。
units.en: When censors protested the arrangement, the Empress Dowager was furious and wished to dismiss them; Hongzao warned that this would lose the trust of officials and subjects alike, and she relented.
units.literal: When remonstrating officials spoke of the inconvenience of this, the Empress Dowager was greatly angered and wished to dismiss them; Hongzao said that to do so would surely lose the hopes of all officials and people under Heaven, and she desisted.

units.zh: 所薦引多端士。
units.en: Those he recommended were mostly men of talent.
units.literal: Those he recommended and advanced were mostly men of talent.

units.zh: 朝列有清望者，率倚以為重，然亦不免被劫持雲。
units.en: Officials at court with reputations for integrity generally looked to him for support, yet he could not escape being manipulated, it is said.
units.literal: Officials at court with pure reputations generally relied on him as a weighty support, yet he could not avoid being manipulated, it is said.

units.zh: 翁同龢，字叔平，江蘇常熟人，大學士心存子。
units.en: Weng Tonghe, courtesy name Shuping, was from Changshu in Jiangsu, son of Grand Secretary Weng Xincun.
units.literal: Weng Tonghe, styled Shuping, was a native of Changshu in Jiangsu, son of Grand Secretary Xincun.

units.zh: 咸豐六年一甲一名進士，授修撰。
units.en: In 1856 he took first place in the jinshi examination and was appointed drafting compiler.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Xianfeng he passed the jinshi examination as top graduate of the first class and was appointed drafting compiler.

units.zh: 八年，典試陝甘，旋授陝西學政，乞病回京。
units.en: In 1858 he presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu examination, was soon appointed educational commissioner of Shaanxi, then asked leave on grounds of illness and returned to the capital.
units.literal: In the eighth year he presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu examination, was soon appointed educational commissioner of Shaanxi, and asked leave on grounds of illness to return to the capital.

units.zh: 同治元年，擢贊善。
units.en: In 1862 he was promoted to attendant in the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was promoted to attendant in the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 典山西試。
units.en: He presided over the Shanxi provincial examination.
units.literal: He presided over the Shanxi examination.

units.zh: 父憂歸，服闋，轉中允。
units.en: After his father's death he returned home to mourn; when mourning ended he was transferred to junior mentor in the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: When his father died he returned home in mourning; when mourning ended he was transferred to junior mentor.

units.zh: 命在弘德殿行走，五日一進講，於簾前說治平寶鑑，兩宮皇太后嘉之。
units.en: He was ordered to serve in Hongde Hall, lecturing every five days; before the screen he expounded the Mirror of Governance and Peace, and both Empress Dowagers praised him.
units.literal: He was ordered to attend at Hongde Hall, lecturing once every five days; before the screen he expounded the Mirror of Governance and Peace, and both Empress Dowagers praised him.

units.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
units.en: He rose step by step to academician of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He was promoted in succession to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 母憂服闋，起故官。
units.en: When his mourning for his mother ended, he returned to his former office.
units.literal: When mourning for his mother ended, he resumed his former post.

units.zh: 同龢居講席，每以憂勤惕厲，啟沃聖心。
units.en: At the lectern Tonghe constantly urged diligence and restraint upon the young emperor and nurtured his mind.
units.literal: Tonghe held the lectern and, with anxious diligence and vigilant self-restraint, nurtured the emperor's mind.

units.zh: 當八年武英殿之災也，恭錄康熙、嘉慶兩次遇災修省聖訓進禦，疏言：「變不虛生，遇災而懼。
units.en: When the Hall of Martial Glory burned in 1872, he respectfully copied the Kangxi and Jiaqing emperors' instructions on self-examination after disasters and presented them to the throne, writing: "Calamities do not strike without cause; one must tremble when they come.
units.literal: When in the eighth year the Hall of Martial Glory burned, he respectfully copied the sacred instructions on self-examination from the Kangxi and Jiaqing reigns after calamities and presented them to the throne, memorializing: "Calamities do not arise without cause; one must fear when calamity strikes.

units.zh: 宜停不急之工，惜無名之費。
units.en: Nonessential projects should be halted and wasteful spending curtailed.
units.literal: Nonurgent works should be halted and pointless expenditures spared.

units.zh: 開直臣忠諫之路，杜小人幸進之門。」
units.en: The path for upright ministers to speak frankly should be opened, and the door for petty men to advance by favor should be closed."
units.literal: The path for upright ministers to offer loyal remonstrance should be opened, and the door for petty men to advance by favor should be shut."

units.zh: 上覽奏動容。
units.en: The emperor was visibly moved when he read the memorial.
units.literal: When the emperor read the memorial, his expression changed.

units.zh: 又圓明園方興工，商人李光昭矇報木價，為李鴻章所劾論罪。
units.en: Work had meanwhile begun on the Old Summer Palace; merchant Li Guangzhao had fraudulently inflated timber prices and was impeached and punished by Li Hongzhang.
units.literal: Meanwhile work had begun on the Old Summer Palace; the merchant Li Guangzhao had fraudulently reported timber prices and was impeached and punished by Li Hongzhang.

units.zh: 廷臣多執此入諫，恭親王等尤力諍，上不懌。
units.en: Many officials used the case to remonstrate; Prince Gong and others argued especially forcefully, and the emperor was displeased.
units.literal: Many court officials used this case to remonstrate; Prince Gong and others argued especially forcefully, and the emperor was displeased.

units.zh: 同龢面陳江南輿論，中外人心惶惑，請聖意先定，待時興修。
units.en: Tonghe reported in person the public mood in Jiangnan: officials and people at home and abroad were anxious; he asked the emperor to settle his mind first and undertake repairs when the time was right.
units.literal: Tonghe stated in person the public opinion of Jiangnan: officials and people at home and abroad were anxious and confused; he asked that the emperor's mind be settled first and repairs undertaken when the time was right.

units.zh: 乃議定停園工，並有停工程、罷浮費、求直言之諭。
units.en: The palace works were halted, and edicts followed to stop projects, cut wasteful spending, and invite frank counsel.
units.literal: Thereupon it was decided to halt the palace works, and edicts were issued to stop projects, abolish wasteful spending, and seek forthright speech.

units.zh: 光緒元年，署刑部右侍郎。
units.en: In 1875 he served as acting Right Vice Minister of Justice.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he served as acting Right Vice Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 明年四月，上典學毓慶宮，命授讀，再辭，不允。
units.en: The following April the emperor began his studies at the Palace of Accumulated Joy; Tonghe was ordered to tutor him, declined twice, and was not allowed to refuse.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the next year the emperor began his studies at the Palace of Accumulated Joy; Tonghe was ordered to tutor him, declined twice, and was not permitted to refuse.

units.zh: 旋遷戶部，充經筵講官，晉都察院左都御史。
units.en: He was soon transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, appointed lecturer at the Classics Colloquium, and promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, appointed lecturer at the imperial lectures, and advanced to Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate.

units.zh: 遷刑部尚書，調工部。
units.en: He was transferred to Minister of Justice, then to the Ministry of Works.
units.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Justice and then to the Ministry of Works.

units.zh: 六年，廷臣爭俄約久不決，懿旨派惇親王、醇親王及同龢與潘祖廕每日在南書房看摺件電報，擬片進呈取進止，至俄約改定始止。
units.en: In 1880 the court disputed the Russian treaty for months; an imperial decree assigned Princes Dun and Chun, together with Tonghe and Pan Zuyin, to review memorials and telegrams daily in the Southern Library and draft recommendations for the throne, continuing until the treaty was revised.
units.literal: In the sixth year court officials disputed the Russian treaty for a long time without resolution; an imperial decree assigned Princes Dun and Chun, together with Tonghe and Pan Zuyin, to review memorials and telegrams daily in the Southern Library, draft briefs for presentation and await decisions, continuing until the Russian treaty was revised.

units.zh: 八年，命充軍機大臣。
units.en: In 1882 he was appointed to the Grand Council.
units.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed a Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 十年，法越事起，同龢主一面進兵，一面與議，庶有所備。
units.en: In 1884 war broke out between France and Vietnam; Tonghe argued for advancing troops while negotiating, so the court would not be caught unprepared.
units.literal: In the tenth year hostilities arose between France and Vietnam; Tonghe held that troops should advance on one hand while negotiations proceeded on the other, so that some preparedness might be maintained.

units.zh: 又言劉永福不足恃，非增重兵出關不可。
units.en: He also argued that Liu Yongfu could not be relied upon and that substantial reinforcements must be sent beyond the frontier passes.
units.literal: He also said that Liu Yongfu could not be relied upon and that substantial reinforcements must be sent beyond the passes.

units.zh: 旋與軍機王大臣同罷，仍直毓慶宮。
units.en: He was soon dismissed along with the princely Grand Councilors but continued to serve at the Palace of Accumulated Joy.
units.literal: Soon he was dismissed along with the princely Grand Councilors but continued to attend at the Palace of Accumulated Joy.

units.zh: 前後充會試總裁、順天鄉試考官，兩蒙賜「壽」，加太子太保，賜雙眼花翎、紫韁。
units.en: He served as chief examiner of the metropolitan examination and examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination, twice received the character "Longevity" as an imperial gift, was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and was granted double-eyed peacock feathers and a purple bridle.
units.literal: Before and after he served as chief examiner of the metropolitan examination and examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination, twice received the character "Longevity" as a gift, was given Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and was granted double-eyed peacock feathers and a purple bridle.

units.zh: 嘗請假修墓，傳旨海上風險，命馳驛回京，恩眷甚篤。
units.en: Once he asked leave to repair his family's tombs; an edict cited the dangers at sea and ordered him back to the capital by courier post—a mark of exceptional favor.
units.literal: Once he asked leave to repair his family's tombs; an edict noted the dangers at sea and ordered him to return to the capital by courier post; imperial favor was very deep.

units.zh: 二十年，再授軍機大臣。
units.en: In 1894 he was again appointed to the Grand Council.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he was again appointed a Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 懿旨命撤講，上請如故。
units.en: An imperial decree ordered his tutoring duties withdrawn; the emperor asked that they continue unchanged.
units.literal: An imperial decree ordered his tutoring duties withdrawn; the emperor asked that they continue as before.

units.zh: 同龢善伺上意，得遇事進言。
units.en: Tonghe was skilled at reading the emperor's mind and seized occasions to offer counsel.
units.literal: Tonghe was skilled at discerning the emperor's intent and was able to offer counsel when occasions arose.

units.zh: 上親政久，英爽非復常度，剖決精當。
units.en: The emperor had long ruled in person; his keen intelligence and precise judgments were no longer those of an ordinary monarch.
units.literal: The emperor had long ruled in person; his keen intelligence was no longer ordinary, and his judgments were precise and apt.

units.zh: 每事必問同龢，眷倚尤重。
units.en: On every matter he consulted Tonghe; his reliance on him was especially heavy.
units.literal: On every matter he would consult Tonghe; reliance upon him was especially heavy.

units.zh: 時日韓起釁，同龢與李鴻藻主戰，孫毓汶、徐用儀主和。
units.en: When war broke out between Japan and Korea, Tonghe and Li Hongzao favored fighting while Sun Yuwen and Xu Yongyi favored peace.
units.literal: At that time hostilities arose between Japan and Korea; Tonghe and Li Hongzao favored war, while Sun Yuwen and Xu Yongyi favored peace.

units.zh: 會海陸軍皆敗，懿旨命赴天津傳諭李鴻章詰責之，同龢並言太后意決不即和。
units.en: When both navy and army were defeated, an imperial decree sent him to Tianjin to rebuke Li Hongzhang; Tonghe also reported that the Empress Dowager was firmly set against immediate peace.
units.literal: When both the navy and army were defeated, an imperial decree ordered him to go to Tianjin and convey instructions rebuking Li Hongzhang; Tonghe also stated that the Empress Dowager's mind was firmly set against immediate peace.

units.zh: 歸薦唐仁廉忠赤可用，請設巡防處籌辦團防。
units.en: On his return he recommended Tang Renlian as loyal and capable and asked that a patrol defense office be established to organize local militia.
units.literal: On his return he recommended Tang Renlian as loyal and usable and asked that a patrol defense office be established to organize local militia defense.

units.zh: 於是命恭親王督辦軍務，同龢、鴻藻等會商辦理。
units.en: Prince Gong was then ordered to supervise military affairs, with Tonghe, Hongzao, and others to consult and handle matters jointly.
units.literal: Thereupon Prince Gong was ordered to supervise military affairs, with Tonghe, Hongzao, and others to consult and handle matters jointly.

units.zh: 上嘗問諸臣：「時事至此，和戰皆無可恃！」
units.en: The emperor once asked his ministers: "Affairs have come to this pass—neither peace nor war offers any hope!"
units.literal: The emperor once asked his ministers: "Affairs have come to this pass—neither peace nor war can be relied upon!"

units.zh: 言及宗社，聲淚並發。
units.en: Speaking of the fate of the dynasty, his voice broke and tears flowed together.
units.literal: Speaking of the altars of state, his voice and tears burst forth together.

units.zh: 及和議起，同龢與鴻藻力爭改約稿，並陳：「寧增賠款，必不可割地。」
units.en: When peace talks began, Tonghe and Hongzao fought vigorously to revise the draft treaty, arguing together: "Better to increase indemnities than to cede territory."
units.literal: When peace negotiations began, Tonghe and Hongzao fought vigorously to revise the draft treaty, stating together: "Better to increase indemnities than to cede territory."

units.zh: 上曰：「台灣去，則人心皆去。
units.en: The emperor said: "If Taiwan is lost, the hearts of the people will go with it.
units.literal: The emperor said: "If Taiwan is lost, the hearts of the people will all be lost.

units.zh: 朕何以為天下主？」
units.en: How can I remain sovereign over the realm?"
units.literal: How can I remain sovereign over the realm?"

units.zh: 毓汶以前敵屢敗對，上責以賞罰不嚴，故至於此。
units.en: Yuwen cited repeated defeats in reply; the emperor blamed lax discipline in rewards and punishments for having brought matters to this pass.
units.literal: Yuwen replied citing repeated defeats at the front; the emperor blamed lax rewards and punishments for having brought matters to this pass.

units.zh: 諸臣皆引咎。
units.en: All the ministers accepted blame.
units.literal: All the ministers accepted blame.

units.zh: 上以和約事徘徊不能決，天顏憔悴。
units.en: The emperor wavered over the peace treaty, unable to decide; his face showed the strain.
units.literal: The emperor wavered over the peace treaty and could not decide; his countenance was haggard.

units.zh: 同龢以俄、英、德三國謀阻割地，請展期換約，以待轉圜。
units.en: Tonghe argued that Russia, Britain, and Germany were working to block territorial cession and asked to postpone ratification in hope of a better outcome.
units.literal: Tonghe held that Russia, Britain, and Germany were working to block the cession of territory and asked that exchange of the treaty be postponed to await a turn for the better.

units.zh: 與毓汶等執爭，終不可挽，和約遂定。
units.en: He argued fiercely with Yuwen and others, but could not turn the tide, and the peace treaty was settled.
units.literal: He argued fiercely with Yuwen and others, but in the end could not turn the tide, and the peace treaty was settled.

units.zh: 明年，兼總理各國事務大臣。
units.en: The following year he was concurrently appointed minister for foreign affairs.
units.literal: The next year he was concurrently appointed minister for foreign affairs with all nations.

units.zh: 二十三年，以戶部尚書協辦大學士。
units.en: In 1897, as Minister of Revenue, he was made associate grand secretary.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year, as Minister of Revenue he served as associate grand secretary.

units.zh: 二十四年，上初召用主事康有為，議行新政。
units.en: In 1898 the emperor first summoned the chief clerk Kang Youwei and discussed implementing the new policies.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the emperor first summoned and employed the chief clerk Kang Youwei and discussed implementing the new policies.

units.zh: 四月，硃諭：「協辦大學士翁同龢近來辦事多不允協，以致眾論不服，屢經有人參奏。
units.en: In April an edict in vermilion ink stated: "Associate Grand Secretary Weng Tonghe has of late handled affairs in ways that accord poorly with others, provoking widespread dissatisfaction and repeated impeachments.
units.literal: In the fourth month an edict in vermilion ink stated: "Associate Grand Secretary Weng Tonghe of late has handled affairs in ways that accord poorly with others, so that public opinion is dissatisfied and he has repeatedly been impeached.

units.zh: 且每於召對時諮詢事件，任意可否，喜怒見於詞色，漸露攬權狂悖情狀，斷難勝樞機之任。
units.en: At imperial audiences he arbitrarily assents or denies, his joy and anger plain in word and face, gradually revealing a disposition to usurp power in reckless defiance—clearly unfit for the Grand Council.
units.literal: Moreover, at each imperial audience when events are consulted, he arbitrarily assents or denies, joy and anger showing in his words and expression, gradually revealing a disposition to usurp power in reckless defiance—he clearly cannot bear the duties of the Grand Council.

units.zh: 本應查明究辦，予以重懲；
units.en: He ought to be investigated and severely punished;
units.literal: He ought to be investigated and severely punished;

units.zh: 姑念其在毓慶宮行走有年，不忍遽加嚴譴。
units.en: yet considering his many years of service at the Palace of Accumulated Joy, severe punishment is withheld for now.
units.literal: yet considering that he has attended at the Palace of Accumulated Joy for many years, severe punishment is not immediately imposed.

units.zh: 翁同龢著即開缺回籍，以示保全。」
units.en: Weng Tonghe is forthwith to leave office and return home, as an act of leniency."
units.literal: Weng Tonghe is forthwith to vacate his post and return to his native place, as a sign of preservation."

units.zh: 八月，政變作，太后復訓政。
units.en: In August a coup occurred and the Empress Dowager resumed regency.
units.literal: In the eighth month a political coup occurred and the Empress Dowager resumed regency.

units.zh: 十月，又奉硃諭：「翁同龢授讀以來，輔導無方，往往巧藉事端，刺探朕意。
units.en: In October another vermilion edict read: "Since Weng Tonghe began tutoring, his guidance has been inept; he often craftily seized pretexts to probe my intentions.
units.literal: In the tenth month he again received an edict in vermilion ink: "Since Weng Tonghe began tutoring, his guidance has been without method; he often craftily seized upon pretexts to probe my intentions.

units.zh: 至甲午年中東之役，信口侈陳，任意慫恿。
units.en: In the Sino-Japanese War of 1894–95 he spoke recklessly and urged me on at will.
units.literal: As for the Sino-Japanese war in the jiawu year, he spoke recklessly and extravagantly and urged me on at will.

units.zh: 辦理諸務，種種乖謬，以致不可收拾。
units.en: In handling affairs he erred in every way until matters became beyond repair.
units.literal: In handling various affairs he was wrong in every way, until matters became beyond repair.

units.zh: 今春力陳變法，濫保非人，罪無可逭。
units.en: This spring he strongly urged reform and recklessly recommended unworthy men—crimes that admit no excuse.
units.literal: This spring he strongly urged reform and recklessly recommended unworthy men—his crimes admit no escape.

units.zh: 事後追維，深堪痛恨！
units.en: Looking back, this is deeply to be regretted!
units.literal: Looking back afterward, this is deeply to be hated!

units.zh: 前令其開缺回籍，實不足以蔽辜，翁同龢著革職，永不敘用，交地方官嚴加管束。」
units.en: The earlier order to send him home in truth does not cover his guilt; Weng Tonghe is dismissed from office, never to be employed again, and handed over to local officials for strict supervision."
units.literal: The earlier order for him to vacate his post and return home in truth does not cover his guilt; Weng Tonghe is dismissed from office, never to be employed again, and handed over to local officials for strict supervision."

units.zh: 三十年，卒於家，年七十有五。
units.en: In 1904 he died at home at the age of seventy-five.
units.literal: In the thirtieth year he died at home at the age of seventy-five.

units.zh: 宣統元年，詔復原官。
units.en: In 1909 an edict restored his former rank.
units.literal: In the first year of Xuantong an edict restored his former rank.

units.zh: 後追諡文恭。
units.en: He was later given the posthumous title Wengong.
units.literal: Later he was posthumously given the title Wengong.

units.zh: 同龢久侍講幃，參機務，遇事專斷。
units.en: Tonghe long served at the imperial lectures and on confidential affairs, deciding matters on his own authority.
units.literal: Tonghe long attended the imperial lectures and took part in confidential affairs, deciding matters on his own authority.

units.zh: 與左右時有爭執，群責怙權。
units.en: He frequently quarreled with colleagues, and many blamed him for monopolizing power.
units.literal: He frequently quarreled with those around him, and the multitude blamed him for monopolizing power.

units.zh: 晚遭讒沮，幾獲不測，遂斥逐以終。
units.en: In his later years he suffered slander, nearly met with disaster, and ended by being driven out in disgrace.
units.literal: In his later years he suffered slander and obstruction, nearly met with disaster, and ended by being driven out in disgrace.

units.zh: 著有瓶廬詩稿八卷、文稿二十卷。
units.en: He left eight juan of poetry and twenty juan of prose from the Pinglu Studio.
units.literal: He authored eight juan of poetry drafts from the Pinglu Studio and twenty juan of prose drafts.

units.zh: 其書法自成一家，尤為世所宗雲。
units.en: His calligraphy formed a school of its own and was especially revered, it is said.
units.literal: His calligraphy formed a school of its own and was especially honored by the world, it is said.

units.zh: 孫毓汶，字萊山，山東濟寧州人，尚書瑞珍子。
units.en: Sun Yuwen, courtesy name Laishan, was from Jining Prefecture in Shandong, son of Minister Sun Ruizhen.
units.literal: Sun Yuwen, styled Laishan, was a native of Jining Prefecture in Shandong, son of Minister Ruizhen.

units.zh: 咸豐六年，以一甲二名進士授編修。
units.en: In 1856 he took second place in the jinshi examination and was appointed a compiler.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Xianfeng he passed the jinshi examination as second graduate of the first class and was appointed compiler.

units.zh: 八年，丁父憂。
units.en: In 1858 he withdrew to mourn his father.
units.literal: In the eighth year he entered mourning for his father.

units.zh: 十年，以在籍辦團抗捐被劾，革職遣戍。
units.en: In 1860, for organizing local militia at home and resisting tax levies, he was impeached, dismissed, and banished.
units.literal: In the tenth year, for organizing local militia at home and resisting levies, he was impeached, dismissed from office, and banished.

units.zh: 恭親王以毓汶世受國恩，首抗捐餉，深惡之。
units.en: Prince Gong deeply detested him, holding that a family long favored by the state should not have been foremost in resisting tax levies.
units.literal: Prince Gong held that Yuwen's family had long received the state's grace yet was foremost in resisting levies and supplies, and deeply detested him.

units.zh: 同治元年，以輸餉復原官。
units.en: In 1862 he was restored to office for contributing supplies to the war effort.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was restored to his former rank for contributing supplies.

units.zh: 五年，大考一等一名，擢侍講學士。
units.en: In 1866 he placed first in the palace examination and was promoted to lecturing academician.
units.literal: In the fifth year, in the triennial examination he ranked first in the first class and was promoted to lecturing academician.

units.zh: 先後典四川鄉試，督福建學政。
units.en: He presided over the Sichuan provincial examination and served as educational commissioner for Fujian.
units.literal: He successively presided over the Sichuan provincial examination and supervised education in Fujian.

units.zh: 光緒元年，丁母憂。
units.en: In 1875 he withdrew to mourn his mother.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he entered mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 服闋，起故官。
units.en: When mourning ended he returned to his former office.
units.literal: When mourning ended he resumed his former post.

units.zh: 尋遷詹事，視學安徽。
units.en: He was soon made junior mentor and sent to inspect education in Anhui.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to junior mentor and inspected education in Anhui.

units.zh: 擢內閣學士，授工部左侍郎。
units.en: He was promoted to grand secretary and appointed Left Vice Minister of Works.
units.literal: He was promoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat and appointed Left Vice Minister of Works.

units.zh: 十年，命赴江南等省按事。
units.en: In 1884 he was ordered to Jiangnan and other provinces to investigate affairs.
units.literal: In the tenth year he was ordered to go to Jiangnan and other provinces to investigate affairs.

units.zh: 時法越事起，毓汶以習於醇親王，漸與聞機要。
units.en: When war broke out between France and Vietnam, Yuwen, being close to Prince Chun, gradually gained access to confidential affairs.
units.literal: At that time hostilities arose between France and Vietnam; Yuwen, being familiar with Prince Chun, gradually came to hear confidential matters.

units.zh: 適奉硃諭盡罷軍機王大臣，毓汶還，遂命入直軍機，兼總理各國事務大臣。
units.en: Just then a vermilion edict dismissed all the princely Grand Councilors; when Yuwen returned he was appointed to the Grand Council and concurrently made minister for foreign affairs.
units.literal: Just then a vermilion edict dismissed all the princely Grand Councilors; when Yuwen returned, he was ordered to attend on the Grand Council and concurrently serve as minister for foreign affairs.

units.zh: 時當國益厭言路紛囂，出張佩綸等會辦南北洋、閩海軍務，餘亦因事先後去之，風氣為之一變。
units.en: Those in power had grown weary of censorial clamor; Zhang Peilun and others were sent out to handle naval affairs, and the rest left one after another on various pretexts—the political climate changed at once.
units.literal: At that time those in power grew ever more weary of the censorial clamor; Zhang Peilun and others were sent out to jointly handle naval affairs on the northern and southern coasts and in Fujian, and the rest also left one after another on various pretexts—the climate of opinion changed at once.

units.zh: 十五年，擢刑部尚書，尋調兵部，加太子少保。
units.en: In 1889 he was promoted to Minister of Justice, soon transferred to the Ministry of War, and made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Minister of Justice, soon transferred to the Ministry of War, and given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 歷典會試、順天鄉試，賞黃馬褂、雙眼花翎、紫韁。
units.en: He presided over the metropolitan and Shuntian provincial examinations and was rewarded with a yellow jacket, double-eyed peacock feathers, and a purple bridle.
units.literal: He successively presided over the metropolitan and Shuntian provincial examinations and was rewarded with a yellow jacket, double-eyed peacock feathers, and a purple bridle.

units.zh: 二十年，中日媾和，李鴻章遣人齎約至。
units.en: In 1894 China and Japan made peace; Li Hongzhang sent an envoy bearing the treaty.
units.literal: In the twentieth year China and Japan made peace; Li Hongzhang sent someone bearing the treaty.

units.zh: 廷臣章奏凡百上，皆斥和非計。
units.en: Court officials submitted hundreds of memorials, all denouncing peace as folly.
units.literal: Court officials submitted memorials by the hundreds, all denouncing peace as no plan.

units.zh: 翁同龢、李鴻藻主緩，俄、法、德三國亦請毋遽換約。
units.en: Weng Tonghe and Li Hongzao favored delay; Russia, France, and Germany also asked that ratification not be rushed.
units.literal: Weng Tonghe and Li Hongzao favored delay; Russia, France, and Germany also asked that the treaty not be exchanged hastily.

units.zh: 毓汶素與鴻章相結納，力言戰不可恃，亟請署，上為流涕書之，和約遂成。
units.en: Yuwen had long been allied with Li Hongzhang; he argued that war was hopeless and urgently pressed for signature; the emperor wept as he gave his approval, and the peace treaty was concluded.
units.literal: Yuwen had long been allied with Hongzhang; he strongly argued that war could not be relied upon and urgently asked to sign; the emperor wept as he wrote his approval, and the peace treaty was concluded.

units.zh: 明年，稱疾乞休。
units.en: The following year he asked to retire on grounds of illness.
units.literal: The next year he asked to retire on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 二十五年，卒，予諡文恪。
units.en: In 1899 he died and was given the posthumous title Wenkai.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he died and was given the posthumous title Wenkai.

units.zh: 毓汶權奇饒智略，直軍機逾十年。
units.en: Yuwen was resourceful and shrewd; he served on the Grand Council for more than a decade.
units.literal: Yuwen was resourceful and possessed abundant stratagems; he attended on the Grand Council for more than ten years.

units.zh: 初，醇親王以尊親參機密，不常入直，疏牘日送邸閱，謂之「過府」。
units.en: At first Prince Chun, as an imperial kinsman in confidential affairs, did not regularly attend council sessions; memorials were sent daily to his residence for review—called "passing through the mansion."
units.literal: At first Prince Chun, as an imperial kinsman participating in confidential affairs, did not regularly attend council sessions; memorials were sent daily to his residence for review—this was called "passing through the mansion."

units.zh: 諭旨陳奏，皆毓汶為傳達。
units.en: Imperial instructions and memorials all passed through Yuwen.
units.literal: Imperial instructions and memorial presentations were all conveyed by Yuwen.

units.zh: 同列或不得預聞，故其權特重雲。
units.en: His colleagues sometimes learned of matters only afterward; his authority was therefore especially great, it is said.
units.literal: His colleagues sometimes could not learn of matters beforehand; therefore his authority was especially weighty, it is said.

units.zh: 論曰：光緒初元，复逢訓政，勵精圖治，宰輔多賢，頗有振興之象。
units.en: The historian comments: At the beginning of Guangxu's reign, with regency resumed, the court strove to govern well and many capable ministers served at the top—there was an air of revival.
units.literal: The historian comments: At the beginning of Guangxu, regency was resumed; the court strove to govern well, and many capable ministers served as chief counselors—there was quite an air of revival.

units.zh: 首輔文祥既逝，沈桂芬等承其遺風，以忠懇結主知，遇事能持之以正，雖無老成，尚有典型。
units.en: After Chief Minister Wen Xiang died, Shen Guifen and others inherited his approach; with loyal sincerity they won the ruler's trust and upheld principle in affairs—though lacking seasoned maturity, they still offered a model to follow.
units.literal: After Chief Minister Wen Xiang died, Shen Guifen and others inherited his legacy; with loyal sincerity they won the ruler's trust, and in handling affairs could uphold rectitude—though lacking seasoned maturity, there remained a model to follow.

units.zh: 及甲申法越、甲午日韓，外患內憂，國家多故。
units.en: By the Franco-Vietnamese War of 1884 and the Sino-Japanese War of 1894–95, foreign threats and domestic troubles multiplied and the state faced one crisis after another.
units.literal: By the jiashen Franco-Vietnamese conflict and the jiawu Sino-Japanese-Korean crisis, foreign troubles and internal anxieties multiplied and the state faced many emergencies.

units.zh: 慈聖倦勤，經營園囿，稍事遊幸，而政紀亦漸弛矣。
units.en: The Empress Dowager grew weary of governing, devoted herself to gardens and parks, undertook occasional excursions, and governance gradually slackened.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager grew weary of diligence, devoted herself to gardens and parks, undertook occasional excursions, and governance gradually slackened.

units.zh: 鴻藻久參樞密，眷遇獨隆。
units.en: Hongzao long served on the Grand Council and enjoyed uniquely lofty favor.
units.literal: Hongzao long participated in confidential council affairs and enjoyed uniquely lofty favor.

units.zh: 桂芬以持重見賞，同龢以專斷致嫌。
units.en: Guifen was valued for his steadiness; Tonghe incurred dislike for deciding matters on his own authority.
units.literal: Guifen was valued for his steadiness; Tonghe incurred dislike for his arbitrary decisions.

units.zh: 毓汶奔走其間，勤勞亦著，大體彌縫，賴以無事。
units.en: Yuwen shuttled among them with notable diligence; by smoothing matters over in the main, the court relied on him to keep affairs running.
units.literal: Yuwen hurried back and forth among them; his diligence was also notable, and by smoothing over matters in the main, the court relied on him to keep things untroubled.

units.zh: 然以政見異同，門戶之爭，牽及朝局，至數十年而未已。
units.en: Yet differences in political views and factional struggles drew in the court itself, and this continued for decades without end.
units.literal: Yet because of differences in political views and factional struggles, the court was drawn in, and this continued for decades without end.

units.zh: 賢者之責，亦不能免焉。
units.en: Even worthy men could not escape blame for it.
units.literal: Even men of worth could not escape this responsibility.
